summary.title: REGNSKAPSTJENESTER SØR SA

narrative.text: REGNSKAPSTJENESTER SØR SA is a Norwegian cooperative in "Regnskapsføring og bokføring", registered 1995-02-20.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 6.8 million and an annual result of NOK 196,517.
Registered leadership: Hanne Kari Wedøe (Daglig leder); Knut Lia (Styrets leder).
Head office in Arendal, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
